messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need discrete owners + Jira for each remediation from the cache-thundering incident. Please claim an item today. Goal: remediation + runbook updates by 2025-04-15.

maria: Actions to claim:
• short-term throttle (emergency guardrail)
• runbook + oncall checklist
• alert dedup & routing fixes
• telemetry instrumentation gap
• architecture spike for durable caching

jonah: I'll take the short-term throttle and make the ticket.
jonah: INF-1400 created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1400 — ETA 2025-03-22. Will include canary + rollback steps.

keiko: I'll own runbook + checklist. Creating INF-1401 and will add verification queries. Pairing with @fiona for customer impact wording.
keiko: INF-1401 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1401 — ETA 2025-03-26.

rahul: I'll take alert dedup/routing. Opening INF-1402 and will propose suppression windows for warmup. Need oncall review.
rahul: INF-1402 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1402 — initial PR with rules tomorrow.

fiona: I'll lead telemetry gap ticket. INF-1403 created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1403 — instrument per-prefix miss, prefetch queue length. ETA 2025-04-02.

maria: I'll start the architecture spike for long-term fixes. INF-1404 created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1404 — spike ETA 2025-04-18.

jonah: Quick note — include a maintenance-hand-off checklist in INF-1400 so platform knows when to pick up post-validation.

keiko: RACI proposal (draft):
• Short-term throttle — R: jonah, A: infra lead, C: runtime, I: oncall
• Runbook — R: keiko, A: SRE lead, C: support, I: product
• Alerts — R: rahul, A: SRE lead, C: alerting, I: oncall
• Telemetry — R: fiona, A: obs eng, C: infra, I: product
• Spike — R: maria, A: eng manager, C: research, I: security

rahul: Ops-bot, suggest a 20m sync tomorrow to confirm tickets and acceptance criteria.

ops-bot: Poll: remediation sync — Tomorrow 09:30 PST or Tomorrow 15:00 PST. Vote with :thumbsup: or :hand:.

fiona: 09:30 works.
jonah: 09:30 for me too.
keiko: I'll make 09:30.

maria: Sync scheduled 09:30. Agenda: ticket quick status, canary plan, acceptance criteria.

maria: Final asks: add measurable acceptance criteria to each Jira (e.g., reduce prefix-miss spikes by 75% over 30 days), and paste short rollback commands into the ticket. Ping me when ready for review. Thanks.
